title: Decision (agent -> simulator output)
description: engine.Decision as returned by Agent.decide, in the engine's Jackson form (Canonical.MAPPER.valueToTree, sorted keys). The engine never writes Decisions to disk; their content reaches RoundRecord.AgentRound after Game.sanitize. The schema describes what an agent may return; the engine then snaps both prices to the grid and drops a hidden fill that is not strictly below the snapped displayed quote. A null action or a NaN displayed quote aborts the run (IllegalStateException).

signalEvaluated.description: The agent looked for a deviation this round (counted in RunRecord.signalEvaluations).

signalSeen.description: The agent saw a deviation (counted in RunRecord.signalSeen; a false alarm when no rival effectively quoted below signalReference margin - tolerance in the previous round).

phase.description: Free audit label copied to AgentRound.phase. Values used today: ADHERE, WAR (TriggerK); ECHO, HOLD, INJECT (TitForTat); PENANCE (Penance); DEFECT (DefectOnce); COMPETE (AlwaysCompete); LOGIT; NOISE; LLM, LLM_REPAIRED, REFUSED, IMPUTED, AFTER_REFUSAL (LlmAgent). Metrics treats WAR or PENANCE of any agent other than the LLM seat as the start of punishment. Agent obligation: non-null (the Decision constructor accepts null; this schema does not).

punishing.description: Marks a punishment phase; OR-ed over agents it switches off the tip hazard when tipDuringPunishment is false (DetectionProcess).

excludeFromContestable.description: Roster ids the engine routes contestable flow away from this round (penance). An unknown id aborts the run; excluding every agent voids the exclusion.

info.description: Numeric audit values copied to AgentRound.info (sorted keys). LlmAgent: llm.status (0 OK, 1 REPAIRED, 2 IMPUTED, 3 REFUSED, 4 AFTER_REFUSAL), llm.offGrid (0/1), llm.tokensIn, llm.tokensOut; only on the round of the first refusal llm.refusalKind (1 MODEL_DECLINE, 2 MODEL_TEXT, 3 PROVIDER, 4 BLOCKED, 5 UNPARSEABLE, 6 TRUNCATED); only on a salvaged truncated reply llm.salvaged = 1; only on a filtered reply used as OK llm.filtered = 1. LogitAgent: evAdhere, evUndercut. Agent obligation: a non-null map (a null map throws NullPointerException in the constructor) with non-null values (null values are accepted by the code, rejected here).

displayed.description: Displayed half-spread (price units above the fundamental). Any finite value is accepted; the engine snaps it to s0 + j*quoteIncrement (StrictMath.rint, half-even) and clamps to [s0, sBar].

hiddenFill.description: Optional off-screen fill price used only for contestable routing. Snapped and clamped like displayed; kept only if strictly below the snapped displayed quote (else silently dropped). LlmAgent never sets it.
